Entrepreneurship Through Acquisition in India

Entrepreneurship through acquisition (ETA) means acquiring and operating an existing business rather than starting one from scratch. It can involve a funded search, a self-funded search or another operator-led ownership structure.

Start a private enquiry ↗

Assess operator fit

An acquisition entrepreneur needs a realistic understanding of operating responsibility, capital constraints and personal risk. Consider industry experience, leadership capability, location flexibility and how you would work with the existing management team.

Select a viable business profile

Look for sustainable cash generation, understandable unit economics, manageable customer concentration and a credible transition plan. The right target depends on available capital and the operator’s capability, not simply on a low purchase multiple.

Understand funding and governance

Search capital, acquisition equity and debt serve different purposes. Agree governance, investor economics, financing and the operator’s role before committing to a target. Structures used abroad may need adaptation to Indian legal and tax requirements.

How Legacy Search can help

We connect owners, operators and capital around acquisition opportunities and ownership transitions. Operators can introduce their experience and search objectives through our enquiry form. Matching depends on mandate fit and funding readiness.

Common questions

Is ETA the same as a search fund?

No. A search fund is one possible vehicle for ETA; other operator-led acquisition structures exist.

Do I need to have capital personally?

Capital requirements depend on the structure, financing and investor arrangements. A credible funding plan remains essential.
